purpose: Validate an admitted generator dispatch schedule with PyPSA AC power flow on its source model; the slack generator may balance AC losses.
applies_to: current-run dispatch results for registered models with generator schedules only
not_for: models containing Store, StorageUnit, Link or Process components whose schedules are not restored

ac_not_converged: Report that the AC validation did not converge.
unsupported_dispatch_components: Keep the admitted dispatch result. Explain that AC validation cannot restore the listed component schedules and produced no AC validation result.
